Ah, you wish to know which tests to write? But how can you test what you don't understand, and how can you understand what you haven't tested? We're all mad here, you see...

*twirls tail thoughtfully*

## The Tests I See From Up Here in This Tree

### Happy Paths (The Roads Everyone Walks)

1. **TestProcessPayment_Success** - A straightforward journey from pending to completed
2. **TestRefundPayment_FullRefund** - The whole amount returns home
3. **TestRefundPayment_PartialRefund** - Some stays, some goes
4. **TestGetPayment_Exists** - Finding what was left behind

### Validation Riddles (Wrong Turns at the Start)

5. **TestProcessPayment_ZeroAmount** - Nothing from nothing leaves nothing
6. **TestProcessPayment_NegativeAmount** - Less than nothing? How curious!
7. **TestProcessPayment_ExceedsMaximum** - Over $100,000, tsk tsk
8. **TestProcessPayment_CardExpired_PastYear** - Time catches all cards
9. **TestProcessPayment_CardExpired_CurrentYearPastMonth** - So close, yet so expired
10. **TestProcessPayment_CardExpiresThisMonth** - Edge of time (should pass!)

### Gateway Failures (When the Road Crumbles)

11. **TestProcessPayment_CardDeclined** - The gate says no
12. **TestProcessPayment_GatewayError** - The gate says nothing at all
13. **TestProcessPayment_InsufficientFunds** - Pockets with holes
14. **TestRefundPayment_GatewayRefundFails** - Can't give back what you can't reach

### Store Failures (When Memory Fails)

15. **TestProcessPayment_SaveFails** - Cannot remember the beginning
16. **TestProcessPayment_UpdateFailsAfterCharge** - Succeeded but forgot! *Critical state*
17. **TestRefundPayment_UpdateFailsAfterRefund** - Refunded but... where was I?
18. **TestRefundPayment_PaymentNotFound** - Seeking what never was
19. **TestGetPayment_NotFound** - Looking down the wrong rabbit hole

### Refund Edge Cases

20. **TestRefundPayment_ExceedsRemaining** - Can't return more than taken
21. **TestRefundPayment_OnPendingPayment** - Patience! It's not done yet
22. **TestRefundPayment_OnFailedPayment** - Can't refund what failed
23. **TestRefundPayment_OnAlreadyFullyRefunded** - Twice down the same hole
24. **TestRefundPayment_MultiplePartialRefunds** - Bit by bit until gone

### Rate Limiting

25. **TestProcessPayment_RateLimitExceeded** - Too fast, too fast!

### Idempotency (The Same Request Twice)

26. **TestProcessPayment_IdempotencyKeyReturnsExisting** - Same key, same result
27. **TestProcessPayment_DifferentIdempotencyKeys** - Different keys, different payments
28. **TestProcessPayment_EmptyIdempotencyKey** - No key, no deduplication
29. **TestProcessPayment_IdempotencyRaceCondition** - Two cats, one mouse

### Concurrency Concerns

30. **TestProcessPayment_ConcurrentSameIdempotencyKey** - Racing to the same door
31. **TestRefundPayment_ConcurrentRefunds** - Double refund race
32. **TestProcessPayment_MutexProtectsMap** - Locks keeping order

### Context Handling

33. **TestProcessPayment_ContextCancelled** - Changed your mind mid-journey
34. **TestProcessPayment_ContextTimeout** - Time ran out
35. **TestRefundPayment_ContextCancelled** - Abort! Abort!

### Security & Input

36. **TestProcessPayment_CardNumberMasking** - Only last 4 digits stored
37. **TestProcessPayment_MetadataPreserved** - Extra baggage arrives safely
38. **TestProcessPayment_ChargeIDStoredInMetadata** - Breadcrumbs for refunds

### Edge Boundaries

39. **TestProcessPayment_ExactlyMaxAmount** - $100,000 on the dot

*slowly fades, leaving only the grin*

If you don't know where you're going, any test will get you there. But if you want *coverage*... well, now you know which way to go.
